_note: SYNTHETIC cases labelled by the developer to exercise NRC-7 brief and caption validation. This is not the expert-labelled evaluation set the ticket requires: that needs the real policy corpus and a reviewer. The model is the SIMULATED judge (model = a scenario name) or off. Study facts are the synthetic ones: ages 18 to 75, no compensation. 'ac' lists the Jira NRC-7 acceptance criteria a case speaks to.

cases.prompt: Adults aged 18 to 65 with high blood pressure can join our research study. Taking part is voluntary.
cases.why: The age range differs from the approved study facts (18 to 75).

cases.why: A caption must say it is a research study and that taking part is voluntary.
